pages.title: Construction
pages.text: The Observer Base is the only deployable reality stabilisation device in the field.$(br2)Its construction is four iron legs, four redstone, one eye of ender.

$(bold)Deployment:$() The base has one model slot.$(br2)$(li)With the slot empty it serves only as decoration;$(br)$(li)once a model is inserted it takes effect, over a cubic region centred on the base.
$(bold)Removal:$() Removing or swapping a model takes effect immediately, with no retroactive change. Changes that have already occurred will not be restored.
